sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:39529
Court No. - 15
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 525 of 2025
Applicant :- Shilpi Alias Shilpa Gaur
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijayendra Prakash Tripathi,Harsh Prakash

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J. 
1. Heard Sri Ravindra Kumar Misra, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Vijayendra Prakash Tripathi, the learned counsel for the applicant, as well as Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, the learned AGA for the State, and perused the record.
2. Keeping in view nature of the relief sought and the order proposed to be passed, issuance of notices to opposite party nos. 2, 3 and 4 is dispensed with.

3.Thepresent application under Section 482 CrPC/Section 528 BNSS has been filed seeking issuance of a direction to the Civil Judge, Junior Division/F.T.C. (Crime against Women), Faizabad for expeditious disposal of Case No.408 of 2021 (State Vs. Ankit Gaur and others), arising out of Case Crime No.068 of 2020, under Sections 498A/323/504 and 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 D.P. Act lodged at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ayodhya/Faizabad.

sentences.text: 1 4. The aforesaid case was instituted on the basis of an FIR lodged by the applicant on 21.12.2020.
The trial Court took cognizance of the offence and summoned the accused persons for trial by means of an order dated 23.09.2021.

A copy of the order-sheet of the trial Court annexed with the applicant indicates that the applicant has been diligently pursuing the matter but the base has been repetitively adjourned as some of the accused persons have not put in appearance before the trial Court till date.

5. Keeping in view the aforesaid circumstances, the instant application is disposed of by issuing a direction to theCivil Judge, Junior Division/F.T.C. (Crime against Women), Faizabad to dispose of Case No.408 of 2021 (State Vs. Ankit Gaur and others), arising out of Case Crime No.068 of 2020,
under Sections 498A/323/504 and 506 IPC read with Section 3/4 D.P. Act lodged at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Ayodhya/Faizabad, expeditiously, without granting any unnecessary adjournments to any of the parties and keeping in view the statutory provisions enabling the Court to take suitable steps for ensuring appearance of the accused persons.
Order Date :- 10.7.2025 MVS/-
